verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe a hosted 'Wally Cloud' tier for running models too large for local hardware, with explicit opt-in via --cloud flag, browser sign-in, OpenAI-compatible API, and usage tracking, directly matching the offload story. However, this is entirely vendor-documented with no independent/hands-on confirmation of actually running a large model in the cloud tier, and community threads focus only on the local/on-device engine. missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of the cloud tier working, details on model size limits/catalog available in cloud, and confirmation from community sources.
